slides.headline: When will a robot actually fold your laundry?
Experts say not this decade
slides.body: Robotics leaders agree: capable home robots are 10 to 15 years out, not 2 to 3.

slides.headline: AI brains need robot bodies
slides.body: Smart software exists, but cheap, safe hardware that navigates messy homes does not.

slides.headline: Your Roomba is the peak for now
slides.body: Single-task devices vacuum or mop; a general-purpose helper that cooks and cleans remains science fiction.

slides.headline: Safety and price are the walls
slides.body: A robot strong enough to lift a toddler could hurt one; making it harmless costs more than a car.

slides.headline: Want honest AI timelines?
slides.body: Follow for hype-free updates on what AI actually changes for you.
